title: Personal Services Plan — Recent Cancellation Record and the Hours of a Missed Visit
content:
The Personal Services Plan treats a first missed visit with courtesy and repeated misses more firmly: the hours owed for a late-cancelled or missed visit are multiplied by a pattern multiplier read from the plan's recent record.

## Rule

The pattern multiplier is 1.2 where at least two hours entries for late cancellations or no-shows were posted on the plan in the 6 months before the posting, 0.5 where none was, and 1 where exactly one was. The hours owed are multiplied by the pattern multiplier before they are rounded to two decimal places half up.

**Which entries count.** Hours entries for late cancellations or no-shows are the plan's ledger entries posted for an order with the reason late cancellation or no-show — hours drawn from the plan as well as hours charged at the hourly rate.

**Look-back.** The pattern look-back is counted from each hours entry's posting date to the date the missed visit's hours are posted, a whole month elapsing on the same day of each later month; an entry is counted while fewer than 6 whole months have elapsed.

## Ladder

| Late-cancellation or no-show hours entries in the 6-month look-back | Pattern multiplier |
|---|---|
| None | 0.5 |
| Exactly one | 1 |
| Two or more | 1.2 |

## Boundary of the look-back (hypothetical posting on 20 August)

| Earlier entry posted on | Whole months elapsed | Counted? |
|---|---|---|
| 21 February | 5 | Yes |
| 20 February | 6 | No |

*Hypothetical:* a visit owing 1.0 hour before the pattern multiplier, on a plan with two such entries in the look-back, owes 1.0 multiplied by 1.2, or 1.20 hours; with none in the look-back, 0.50 hour.
